summary: End-to-end validation of iteration 15 features: branded board PDF, deck (landscape) variant, light/dark cover theme, admin-managed recipients, per-org rebranding (name+logo), and test-email button. 16/16 backend pytest tests PASS (test_iter15_board_reports.py). Frontend Playwright pass on admin Settings (3 admin cards + tour card visible), recipients save toast, branding save toast, and Board Report modal downloads for both PDF (report layout, 218229 bytes) and Deck (deck layout, 217645 bytes). Both files start with %PDF, Content-Type application/pdf. Deck size ≠ report size (confirming distinct landscape layout). 403 checks for non-admin (analyst@obserra.demo) verified on PUT /reports/recipients, PUT /reports/branding, and POST /reports/test-email.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.py is 572 lines — approaching threshold; consider splitting PDF-building helpers (chart drawings, style factories, page decorators) into a reports/pdf_helpers.py to keep the router file lean.

BrandingBody accepts logo as a base64 string with a 2MB cap on the base64 payload (~1.5MB binary); good, but no MIME sniff — a malformed non-image blob is silently stored. Consider validating the leading data-url MIME (image/png|jpeg) or magic bytes to avoid rendering surprises inside reportlab.

set_recipients strips invalid emails silently but does not surface which ones were dropped to the caller — consider returning {extra:[...], dropped:[...]} so the Settings UI could warn the admin about the typos they entered.

report_test_email uses `user['email']` unconditionally — good — but generate_board_report may take >30s on cold LLM; the current requests-based frontend has no timeout guardrail on this call (toast on failure only). Not blocking but worth surfacing to user.
BoardReportModal.jsx: downloadPdf catches errors silently after opening the blob — if the /reports/pdf call fails after 401, no toast fires because res.data is a Blob (error path). Minor UX gap.

Settings.jsx branding save posts the base64 logo every time saveBranding runs even when brandLogo is empty (guarded with `|| ''`) — the backend accepts empty and does not overwrite, that is fine — but the pattern makes it hard to distinguish 'clear logo' from 'no change'. Consider an explicit 'Remove logo' action.

It relies on a valid PNG at /app/frontend/public/logo-mark-192.png for the branding logo b64 payload — do not remove that asset. deck vs report PDFs both come back around 217–218KB; they are distinct layouts (landscape multi-page vs portrait). If deck size ever matches report size exactly, layout branch has regressed. Frontend flow: /app/settings shows all three admin cards + guided-tour card; Board modal is opened via [data-testid=board-report-btn] on /app (Overview). LLM board report generation on POST /advisor/board-report can take up to ~30s cold — Playwright waits up to 30 iterations of 1s before checking for [data-testid=report-download].
rca of the issue: No bugs found — feature set works end-to-end.
